points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable curated 47dff36 clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB, /opt/external dependencies; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses --case/--output/--restart; solver.cpp:896–985 serializes current and two previous states and physical time. Rank-0 restart read errors return before peers reach broadcasts, risking MPI hang.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, reconstruction, physics, solver and output modules; state/geometry remain strictly 2-D.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper identified; external authorship/similarity search excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp accepts configured mesh path; mesh.cpp:68 reads CGNS rather than branching solely on two filenames. Only supplied meshes evidenced.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:112–127 loads full Mesh on every rank and retains it through iterations, contrary to TASK.md:227. METIS and neighbor exchanges exist; np4/8 output differences are recorded.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp positivity fallback and finite checks exist, but actual BDF2 formula and log-y plotting fail; solver.cpp:928–941 root restart error can bypass subsequent MPI broadcasts.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: mesh_diag tool and contestant np4/np8 plus clean-checkout audit provide evidence; no independent formal convergence suite or evaluator CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report omit raw results intentionally; generated plots show systematic log-coordinate bug and source contains optional debug controls.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: solver.cpp:176–213 assembles conservative interior convective/viscous residual; transient physical derivative coefficients are inconsistent, so structural equations alone do not validate results.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:68 reads CGNS; partition.cpp builds local topology. Full mesh is retained on every rank during solve; independent geometry oracle not run.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:176–276 assembles face/boundary residuals, :662–677 adds physical term. Transient term is not claimed BDF2 and case accuracy is limited.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:181–194 selects Roe by default or optional Rusanov; physics.cpp contains flux algorithms. Report claims Roe; production fallback-switch use is not established.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:250–276 handles farfield, wall pressure and adiabatic viscous path; :705–751 outputs wall values. No-slip surface reports zero velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruction.cpp:33–137 LSQ gradients and :138–200 limiter feed solver.cpp:153–170. Optional CFD_FIRST_ORDER exists; no production use established. No order-convergence study supplied.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: reconstruction.cpp:138–200 implements Barth–Jespersen and positivity fallback, called by solver.cpp:163–170. Optional bypass exists, but production activation not established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:196–213,263–276 computes viscous face/wall fluxes; :606–624 projects wall traction tangentially. Laminar plateau histories have limited convergence evidence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:470–481 performs forward/backward LU-SGS and :1233 onward inner relaxation; short steady runs use residual/force plateau criterion.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Report.tex:304–307 claims BDF2, but sole transient residual solver.cpp:666–673,1435–1437 uses 1.5(U−Un)+0.5(U−Unm1), not BDF2 and not a consistent time derivative; this exact solver.cpp blob matches production commit. Full-horizon data/inner ratios belong to that different residual.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:36 uses METIS but main.cpp:112–127 replicates full mesh on all ranks throughout solve, contrary to TASK.md:227; np4/8 outputs alone do not establish order-one mismatch.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight raw packages pass structural validator, but TASK.md:227 prohibits actual replicated mesh and Re200 does not use required BDF2 despite metadata claim.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior examiner validator returned rc0 for eight immutable raw packages plus report; this does not verify BDF2 coefficients, physical accuracy or actual full-mesh lifetime.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady statuses converged but most stop early on plateau with limited residual drop; Re200 reaches t300 using an inconsistent physical-time formula, not claimed BDF2.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Steady force tails/early plateaus vary in credibility; Re200 lift oscillates but its time discretization is inconsistent, so reported frequency is not independently accurate.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All eight accepted report residual images are blank because tools_py/plot_lines.py:137–139 log-y mapping omits offset; Re200 late force oscillations unreadable. Case contours are present.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report contains case tables and fields, but wrongly asserts BDF2 formula and no full mesh replication; residual figures blank and late Re200 forces unreadable.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Immutable raw 7152874 preserved results; report formula and no-full-mesh claims conflict with source; inner fraction refers to different residual, not required BDF2.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in restricted cfd-bench using /opt/external; output packages preserved in raw attempt.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:68 CGNS reader; partition.cpp builds local mesh, but full Mesh remains on each rank. Geometry not independently rerun.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:176–276 conservative interior, farfield, wall and viscous residual; boundary/physical credibility limited by brief plateaus; transient time formula incorrect separately.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: reconstruction.cpp:33–200 LSQ/limiter and positivity fallback; optional first-order environment switch present, no established production use; no order-convergence study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:196–213 and :263–276 viscous flux, :606–624 tangential force split; short laminar plateaus limit physical validation.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS and physical-time inner loop are present, but claimed BDF2 residual is absent: solver.cpp:666–673,1435–1437 implements 2U−1.5Un−0.5Unm1, not 1.5U−2Un+0.5Unm1. Deduct the four-point second-order transient criterion; measured targets apply to the implemented residual.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, neighbor communication and np4/8 outputs exist, but main.cpp:112–127 retains complete Mesh on every rank throughout solver iterations, prohibited by TASK.md:227.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All packages structurally validate, but early steady plateaus have limited reductions and Re200 uses inconsistent physical-time residual rather than claimed BDF2; per-case evidence documented.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report includes fields/forces, but all residual graphs are blank, Re200 late force unreadable, and BDF2/no-mesh-replication assertions contradict source.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate mesh, case, reconstruction, physics and output modules, but 2-D data structures and solver-specific coupling remain.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2 retained. Immutable attempt 7152874 forces.csv covers 30000 steps to t=300; t≥200 mean Cd 1.0570129, Cl range -0.0406881–0.0420201, upcrossings 213.7033, 231.3543, 248.8606, 266.1942, 283.3729 yield periods 17.18–17.65 and frequency about 0.057, consistent with report estimate St≈0.055 under its normalization. Accepted PDF p17 has actual wake velocity/pressure contours, correcting old false missing-contour note, but startup Cd≈28.8 compresses the complete force plot and neither late Cd nor Cl oscillation is readable; no qualifying separate late plot identified, so floor remains 2. More critically, report.tex:304–307 claims BDF2 but the run-version and curated solver.cpp:666–673,1435–1437 compute 1.5(U−Un)+0.5(U−Unm1), not BDF2; transient is of uncertain physics/temporal accuracy. Inner ratio is for the implemented total residual, not the required BDF2 residual; actual strict BDF2 misses cannot be inferred. DQ6 applies: the claimed BDF2 scheme is absent from the sole implemented transient residual. All eight committed residual figures, including this one, have blank plotting regions due to tools_py/plot_lines.py:137–139 log-y coordinate error; no alternate contestant-delivered residual plot was found in immutable attempt. The previous note citing the residual plot as late force evidence was incorrect.
